Package com.dfiles.ui

Class ScriptDevPane

java.lang.Object
com.dfiles.ui.ScriptDevPane
public class ScriptDevPane extends Object
Tab 2 content: an AI-assisted bash script workspace split into three mouse-resizable rows — a prompt sent to an LLM (with a choice of AI backend), the resulting or hand-edited script, and a terminal-style view of running it.

This class only builds and exposes the view; it owns no persistence or process-running logic itself. MainController wires its callbacks to AiScriptService, ScriptRunner and the Database.
